selection_method: Positive native-dry-mass-weighted paths; upper quartile eligible path population, then maximum target path in low/high cloud-path quartiles. CF0 rain chooses the low-cloud quartile, CF0 snow the high-cloud quartile to retain substantial examples of each species within the six-case bound; this is not a controlled cross-state attribution. Controls: nearest-center exactly zero positive hydrometeor and zero CF; median-path un-clipped cloudy column with zero CF0 rain/snow. Ties use native row-major order. Ranking thresholds affect point selection only; no production or replay omission threshold.

state_identity.formula: -DNW*(C1H*(MU_2+MUB)+C2H)/gravity; rank paths max(q,0)*mass*1000 in REAL64. Actual wrapper-captured CF/mass/radii may differ and must be recorded; proxies are not optical tau.
